tasks.task: I’m about to post a status update before today’s 5pm check-in. Log in as john, find my tweet that says “Working on a big release today.”, retweet it to boost visibility, then confirm that my retweet_count increased afterward.

success_criteria: get_user_tweets for "john" includes a tweet with content exactly "Working on a big release today." and provides its id.
retweet succeeds for that tweet_id (no refusal / already-retweeted error).
get_user_stats for "john" shows retweet_count increased compared to the pre-retweet baseline (expected +1).

tasks.task: I’m preparing a quick end-of-day update and need it posted before 5pm today. Please log in as john, post a tweet announcing the v1.2.0 shipment with tags #release and #v1.2.0, then mention @eve on that new tweet. Finally, retrieve the tweet to confirm the mention and tags are present.
tasks.reference_answer: {"id": 25, "username": "john", "content": "Shipped v1.2.0 — changelog is live in the docs.", "tags": ["#release", "#v1.2.0"], "mentions": []}

success_criteria: Authentication session is active for username "john" (step 0 returned authenticated/session_active true).
A new tweet is created in step 1 and its returned id is used in subsequent steps.
Step 2 reports successful mention update for username "eve" on the new tweet.
Step 3 returns the tweet whose tags include "#release" and "#v1.2.0" and whose mentions include "@eve".

args.content: Shipped v1.2.0 — changelog is live in the docs.

tasks.task: I’m john and I need to quickly coordinate tomorrow’s bug hunt before 5pm today: find my tweet that says “Bug hunt tomorrow. Bring your sleuthing hats.”, comment “Reminder: bug hunt is tomorrow 10am—please be on time.” on it, and then confirm the comment shows up on that tweet.

success_criteria: Authentication succeeds for username "john" with an active session.
The tweet list for john includes the tweet with content "Bug hunt tomorrow. Bring your sleuthing hats." and its id is used for subsequent steps.
The comment tool returns a success status for that tweet id.
Fetching comments for that tweet id includes a comment with content exactly "Reminder: bug hunt is tomorrow 10am—please be on time."

args.comment_content: Reminder: bug hunt is tomorrow 10am—please be on time.
